title: fix(desktop): keep the conversation TTS lease held across session-tile mount/unmount
claim: A composer that never acquired the shared per-renderer CONVERSATION_LEASE (e.g. a session tile mounting/unmounting) must not release it while another composer's voice conversation holds it.

evidence.red: New test mounting two real useComposerVoice instances (real tts-lease, setTtsLease stubbed) on unpatched main: 'keeps the main conversation lease held while a session tile mounts and unmounts' FAILS: expected [[desktop:conversation:*,true],[desktop:conversation:*,false]] to deeply equal [[desktop:conversation:*,true]] (tile sent a stray release). Owner-unmount guard test passes on main (non-regression guard).
evidence.negative_control: (1) else-if (ownsConversationLeaseRef.current) -> else: test 1 fails with the stray [lease,false]. (2) unmount cleanup guard -> if (true): test 1 fails. Restored -> green.
evidence.adjacent: npx vitest run src/app/chat/composer/hooks src/lib/tts-lease.test.ts: 33 files / 207 tests pass. npm run typecheck clean; eslint + prettier clean on both files.
evidence.source: main use-composer-voice.ts:404-408 unconditional syncTtsLease(CONVERSATION_LEASE, voiceConversationActive && !liveEngineActive) and unmount syncTtsLease(...,false); voiceConversationActive is per-hook useState while tts-lease.ts dedupes on one module-level sent map per lease key.

upstream_overlap: No PR/issue for this defect: gh search (CONVERSATION_LEASE, syncTtsLease, 'tts lease tile', 'conversation lease') and cached 42,912-title scan found none.
